note: WGSN's catwalk library is a subscription source. Nothing here is a public URL and nothing is redistributed: the board this builds carries show names, counts and deep links into WGSN, and only a subscriber's own session can open them. The image files stay on the collecting machine. See docs/wgsn-runway-automation.md.

licence.basis: Subscription content. config/forecast-sources.json already excludes WGSN's paid reports from the public keyword modules; the same rule is applied to its catwalk imagery, so the published board states what exists and links to the source rather than reproducing it.

note_filters: The search page carries its whole state in one URL parameter, `filters`, holding URL-encoded JSON of WGSN's own numeric ids. These were read back off the source URLs recorded with the October 2026 collection, so they are the ids WGSN actually served, not a guess.

shelves.label: 디테일 (신발·액세서리 클로즈업)
shelves.basis: The Details shelf is where a shoe is photographed on its own; a full-length look carries it at a few hundred pixels.

resolutionFloor.note: The October collection's own floor. No upscaling.

librarySearch.note: The saved search the user actually wants collected: WGSN's Fashion Design image library narrowed to footwear tags, where every result is a shoe shot on its own. This is NOT the catwalks search the rest of this file describes - those shelves return whole collections, 1,565 of whose 3,648 images are head-to-toe looks with the shoe at a few hundred pixels. 3,253 results at the time it was shared.
librarySearch.section: Fashion Design > Image Library & Design Resources
librarySearch.caption: Brand / Season / City, as the library prints it under each result.
librarySearch.dedupe: One shoe, one card. The library returns several frames of one look - the October catwalk import had 151 pairs within hamming 4 of each other - so a perceptual hash has to collapse them at collection time, not only the SHA-256 that catches a byte-identical file.
librarySearch.status: not yet collected - needs the logged-in browser session
